Reputational & Crisis Legal Strategy

Some legal problems are also reputational problems — and the two cannot be handled in isolation. A defamation claim, an unauthorized use of your name or likeness, a regulatory investigation that's become public — these situations require counsel who understands that what you file in court and what the world sees are the same event.

What We Protect

Every dimension of the matter, mapped before it moves.

  • —Your name and likeness from unauthorized commercial use
  • —Your reputation from defamation, false light, and public misrepresentation
  • —Your narrative when a dispute becomes public
  • —Your legal position and public standing — simultaneously
